args.title: Prevent CSV rows with same date/amount/description but different currencies from merging
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, causing rows with different currencies to be lost. This happens because the `toDelimited` function likely deduplicates rows based on these fields alone. The fix should ensure that rows with differing currencies are treated as distinct, even if other fields match. Update the logic to preserve all rows when currency differs, or modify the deduplication criteria to include currency as a distinguishing factor.
